case.records.title: Documented engineering cases
case.records.terraform.title: Terraform secret identity collision
case.records.terraform.problem: Renaming for_each keys changed resource addresses while retaining the same physical secret names, blocking apply through name collisions.
case.records.terraform.change: Explicit moved blocks preserved state continuity for the renamed addresses.
case.records.terraform.verification: INC-009 records the failed apply and a reconciliation plan with no resources to destroy.
case.records.terraform.limit: This is a historical reconciliation. Every later plan still requires review for unexpected replacement.
case.records.load.title: Local load validation with a limited CPU budget
case.records.load.problem: Check latency targets with one API process limited to 0.1 CPU and 512 MiB.
case.records.load.change: Ran two isolated k6 workloads with Redis and console email delivery; no real messages were sent.
case.records.load.verification: Each run passed 334 functional checks and completed ten console jobs. All five latency thresholds failed in both runs.
case.records.load.limit: The report dated 2026-10-17 describes a short local experiment, not production SLO compliance or maximum capacity. Performance acceptance remains open.

tradeoffs.json.title: Cached JSON vs. SQL
tradeoffs.json.desc: Versioned JSON files and cached reads keep portfolio content independent of SQL.
tradeoffs.json.limit: Content changes are file-based; this path does not provide transactional storage for editable content.
tradeoffs.delivery.title: Redis Streams vs. background tasks
tradeoffs.delivery.desc: Redis Streams provides classified retries, a dead-letter queue, and pending-job recovery.
tradeoffs.delivery.limit: When the queue is missing or enqueue fails, background delivery has no durability or automatic retries. HTTP acceptance does not prove inbox delivery.
tradeoffs.protection.title: Shared Redis vs. local memory
tradeoffs.protection.desc: Redis coordinates contact rate limits, deduplication, and idempotency across instances.
tradeoffs.protection.limit: Redis errors can fall back to process-local memory, which is not shared across replicas and is lost on restart.
